hints.title: Diagonal Membership Condition
hints.text: Cell (r, c) lies on a diagonal if and only if r == c or r + c == n - 1.

hints.title: Diagonal and Off-Diagonal Tests
hints.text: Diagonal cells must be non-zero numbers. All other cells must be zero values.

hints.title: Early Failure Return
hints.text: Iterate through every cell (r, c) in the grid, returning false upon the first violation.

hints.title: Direct Diagonal Verification Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass over all n^2 grid cells.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex failure mode; simple linear verification.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks both main diagonal and anti-diagonal with condition (r == c or r + c == n - 1).
